basic_details.job_title: Sainik Shiksha Niketan PRT Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Sainik Shiksha Niketan, Purulia will hold a walk-in interview at 0800 hrs on 25 November 2026 at Sainik School Purulia. Candidates must attend with the filled application, educational certificates, bio-data and work experience certificates in original along with attested copies. The interview is for 4 unreserved posts of PRT(Primary Teacher) on contractual basis, with a consolidated salary of Rs. 16,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: About Sainik Shiksha Niketan Purulia
content_sections.text: Sainik Shiksha Niketan, Purulia is a school at Ranchi Road, NH-32, PO: Sainik School - 723104, Dist.: Purulia (WB). The walk-in notice is issued "By Order" of the Chairman, Sainik Shiksha Niketan, and the posts are at Sainik Shiksha Niketan, Purulia.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Sainik Shiksha Niketan Purulia has invited applications for 04 (Four) posts of PRT(Primary Teacher) on contractual basis. All four posts are unreserved. The pay is a consolidated salary of Rs. 16,000/- (Rupees Sixteen Thousand only) per month. Graduation with at least 50% in Higher Secondary. D.El.Ed from an institution recognized by NCTE. Proficiency in writing and teaching in English. B.Ed from recognized university. Knowledge in computer application. Teaching experience. Proficient in Games and Sports, NCC, Co-curricular activities. Classroom teaching skills. B.Ed and teaching experience are listed as desirable, not essential. For the exact wording of each eligibility condition, candidates can refer to the official notification. The age limit for the PRT(Primary Teacher) post is between 21 – 45 years as on 01 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to attend the walk-in interview with: The application (the format is printed in the notice). Educational Certificates. Bio-data. Work experience certificates. Certificates in original and attested copies of certificates. The application format, "Application for the Post of Primary Teacher (PRT)", is printed on pages 2 and 3 of the notice and is addressed to The Chairman, Sainik Shiksha Niketan, Purulia (WB) - 723 104. It asks for the following: Name (in capital letters), father's name, mother's name and permanent address. Mobile number, email ID, gender, date of birth, marital status and Aadhaar card number. Educational qualification, with board/university, division, subjects and remarks. Teaching experience, with institution, designation, from and to dates, and pay drawn. Proficiency in computer with experience (position/responsibilities, language/program used, experience in years/months) and proficiency in games and sports, NCC and co-curricular activities (sport, level of participation, event, position/award). A legal declaration giving details of any disciplinary, vigilance or criminal case (if any), two references (name, relation, appointment, address, contact number), and a signed certificate that the particulars are correct, with place and date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be given for attending the walk-in interview. The school administration reserves the right to cancel the vacancy or change the terms and conditions due to administrative reasons. For more details, the notice asks candidates to follow the Facebook and Instagram pages of Sainik Shiksha Niketan: www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61585434368397 and www.instagram.com/sainikshikshaniketan .

faq.question: Q1. When is the Sainik Shiksha Niketan Purulia PRT walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is at 0800 hrs on 25 November 2026 at Sainik School Purulia.

faq.question: Q2. How many PRT vacancies are there at Sainik Shiksha Niketan Purulia?
faq.answer: There are 04 (Four) posts of PRT(Primary Teacher), all unreserved.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the PRT post?
faq.answer: Candidates need graduation with at least 50% in Higher Secondary, a D.El.Ed from an institution recognized by NCTE, and proficiency in writing and teaching in English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Sainik Shiksha Niketan PRT?
faq.answer: The age must be between 21 – 45 years as on 01 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a PRT at Sainik Shiksha Niketan Purulia?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated salary of Rs. 16,000/- (Rupees Sixteen Thousand only) per month.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the application, educational certificates, bio-data and work experience certificates in original, along with attested copies of the certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Is B.Ed compulsory for the Sainik Shiksha Niketan PRT post?
faq.answer: No, B.Ed from a recognized university is listed as a desirable qualification. The essential teacher-training qualification is D.El.Ed from an NCTE-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q8. Is the PRT post at Sainik Shiksha Niketan permanent?
faq.answer: No, the PRT(Primary Teacher) posts are on contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be given.
